name: Zeref
role: Cory's beast companion; the creature born on the website from real quantum DNA, carried into the ROM
personality: Tiny, fearless, mischievous clown of the cosmos; loyal to the end, laughs at the dark, rawrs at the apocalypse
visual_description: Small black kitten, oversized droopy dark-purple beanie with glowing violet ribbed band, tiny purple-tipped horns, huge purple galaxy eyes full of stars, glowing pink-violet tail tip
idle_pose: Sits upright, tail tip flicking light, beanie slipping over one eye, slow starry blink
cute_creepy_note: When the dark gets close, the stars in its eyes swirl and the horns glow brighter

name: Arin
visual_description: Small figure, oversized soot apron, permanent nose smudge. Black/ember orange. Hammer-blade on back.
idle_pose: Wipes brow, taps hammer on palm
cute_creepy_note: Eyes are two hollow white dots in the dark

name: The Beast (Mote)
visual_description: Round blob body, stubby legs, uneven ears from quantum DNA. Paper-white with one glowing color. Sneezes stars.
cute_creepy_note: Mouth too wide when it yawns; rows of tiny teeth

name: Mote: Linework
visual_description: Same blob, sharper ink outline, tail sprouts. Gains second accent color.

name: Mote: Wash
visual_description: Larger, watercolor bleed fur, small wings or fins by DNA. Glow brighter.

name: Mote: Still Here
visual_description: Big soft silhouette full of tiny stars, rainbow rim light. Same stubby legs.
cute_creepy_note: Inside its body is deep space; things float in it

name: Tattered Traveler
visual_description: Tall ragged robe, face never drawn, just a scribble. Grey on black. Walking stick.
cute_creepy_note: No face. Scribble moves when it talks

name: Master Hollis
visual_description: Broad wide silhouette, burn-scarred arms, leather apron. Brown/orange.

name: Edric Ravenswood
personality: Brave in footnotes, scared in person
visual_description: Thin, round specs, satchel overflowing rubbings. Ink blue.
cute_creepy_note: Specs reflect things not in the room

name: Bryn Hale
visual_description: Stocky, gate armor, short braid, big shield. Steel/red.
cute_creepy_note: Hides a moth jar she secretly feeds

name: Quillan Sorrel
visual_description: Round, robes with soup stains, ladle staff. Green/cream.

name: Sentinel Hesper
visual_description: Tall, snow-white wings, hood, piercing eyes. White/ice blue.
cute_creepy_note: Wings have eyes in the feather tips

name: Grumbleback
personality: Shows up uninvited, sits on things
visual_description: Massive mossy hump, tiny eyes, huge paws. Moss green/stone.
cute_creepy_note: Things live in its moss and wave

name: Rime
visual_description: Lean wolf, frost fur, eyes like still water. White/pale cyan.
cute_creepy_note: Its footprints freeze into tiny faces

name: Cinderwake
visual_description: Flame bird, huge wingspan, ember trail. Red/gold.

name: Elder Thorne
visual_description: Sturdy, stooped, unlit carved pipe. Earth brown/leaf green.

name: Sethra
visual_description: Gardener gloves, hair tied with string, slim. Sage/rust.
cute_creepy_note: Her shadow stands taller than her

name: Malakar
visual_description: Tall coat, ink fingers, staff of rolled maps. Black/parchment.
cute_creepy_note: Ink drips upward from his fingers

name: Counterfeit Angel
visual_description: Perfect white glowing figure, no outline, no shadow. Pure white.
cute_creepy_note: Smile never moves; no shadow ever
